items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: Oh, who'd you listen to? Yeah, Albert Mitchell.

ctx.x: Well I just learned it, picked it up, learned it.

Yeah, I didn't take a lesson. I just would go around and play it in guitar. I don't play in no band, just around the streets you understand? Oh I see. Yes. Then I take the violin, then I start to play it in the band, lead the band. That got too slow and I picked up the connet. I see. I just bought a connet from Naumanela. Nobody gave me a lesson but I know the music. After I got that I just bought the music, I know the music and I just went on. Nobody had learned it and teach me no connet. How did you learn how…
